newsitem.title: USA: Dames & Moore to buy Cleveland Wrecking.
newsitem.headline: Dames & Moore to buy Cleveland Wrecking.

text.p: Dames & Moore Group said Monday one of its affiliates acquired the bank debt of and signed a management deal with Cleveland Wrecking Co, a demolition contractors with 1996 gross revenues of about $50 million.

Dames & Moore said Cleveland Wrecking will be merged with its demolition subsidiary Aman Environmental Construction Inc once Cleveland's nonprofitable operations have been eliminated and agreements have been reached with creditors.
The company said the new operation will use the Cleveland Wrecking name.
Mark Snell, Dames & Moore Group chief financial officer, said the company expects the acquisition to be accretive to earnings for the its current fiscal year ending March 1998.
